modes.automated: The command performs the work and writes a validated artifact.
modes.assisted: The command computes guidance, checks, or partial artifacts; a human finishes the last mile.
modes.advisory: The command produces a plan, checklist, or constraint report for work that must happen inside a vendor application or on a specific device.

Presentation Strategy and Tool Selection.note: brief normalises requirements, scores the 12 platforms, and emits a risk register plus production sequence.

Narrative, Story, and Information Design.note: plan selects a narrative framework from asset-narrative-frameworks.json and lays out section order, slide roles, pacing, and call to action.

Slide and Page Structure.note: plan assigns slide roles and layouts; build renders them; audit reports density and overflow.

Typography and Text Formatting.note: Fonts, sizes, and hierarchy come from the theme preset; audit enforces minimum body size and contrast. Vendor text effects are not rendered.

Shapes, Lines, Geometry, and Object Arra.note: Geometry is computed deterministically for the shipped layouts; arbitrary free-form shape editing stays in the target application.

Images, Icons, Illustration, and Visual.note: plan emits an asset plan with rights fields; audit enforces alt text and decorative flags. No image generation or stock licensing is bundled.

Tables, Charts, Data, and Infographics.note: Metric cards and simple tables render natively; audit runs data-integrity checks (axis cuts, missing sources, percentage totals). Chart images must be supplied.

Audio, Video, Recording, and Media.note: Media plan, caption and rights tracking, playback preflight, and packaging only. No encoder or recorder is bundled.

Animation, Transitions, and Motion Desig.note: Motion is declared in the deck spec and the HTML build honours reduced-motion; audit enforces flash and autoplay limits. PPTX export carries sequential reveal notes rather than authored timelines.

Interactivity, Links, Branching, and Aud.note: The HTML build ships keyboard navigation and link validation; branch maps are documented in the spec for native build-out.

Themes, Templates, Branding, and Design.note: Theme presets drive PPTX theme parts and HTML tokens; audit reports brand drift (fonts, colours, logo, footer).

Collaboration, Review, Approval, and Ana.note: Review checkpoints, handoff manifest, approval gates, and collaboration audit. Multiplayer editing and viewer analytics live in the vendor tools.

Accessibility and Inclusive Presentation.note: Semantic HTML, titles, alt text, reading order, contrast math, and media checks are computed. Manual screen-reader verification is still required.

Export, Conversion, Packaging, and Publi.note: PPTX, HTML, Markdown, speaker notes, and PDF handout are produced natively; convert delegates to an approved local converter when one is installed.

Testing, Troubleshooting, and Presentati.note: Preflight, overflow estimation, fidelity comparison, regression diff, clean-state package verification, and a self-test suite.

Microsoft PowerPoint Mastery.note: Platform profile, PPTX generation with notes, and compatibility audit. Ribbon, Add-in, VBA, and Morph operations must be performed in PowerPoint.

Canva Presentations Mastery.note: Selection guidance, PPTX import path, and export-loss expectations. Canva editing, Brand Kit, and Magic tools are vendor-side.

Apple Keynote Mastery.note: PPTX output is the interchange format; Keynote-specific Magic Move and presenter display work is device-side.

Prezi Mastery.note: Nonlinear story plan and motion-comfort limits are generated; canvas authoring is vendor-side.

Gamma Mastery.note: Card-based async structure is planned and an HTML card deck can be emitted; Gamma account operations are vendor-side.

Pitch Mastery.note: Sales-deck framework plus handoff pack; multiplayer and analytics are vendor-side.

Beautiful.ai Mastery.note: Smart-slide constraint mapping and layout-risk audit; adaptive authoring is vendor-side.

LibreOffice Impress Mastery.note: ODP/PPTX/PDF conversion runs through an approved local soffice binary with a bounded timeout; unit and slide editing stay in Impress.

Zoho Show Mastery.note: Workflow guidance and export checks only; broadcast and WorkDrive operations are vendor-side.

Visme Mastery.note: Interactive and infographic planning; hotspot authoring is vendor-side.

Adobe Express Presentations Mastery.note: Template and asset planning plus export expectations; Firefly and Creative Cloud handoff are vendor-side.

Figma Slides Mastery.note: Design-token translation and developer handoff notes; Figma library and prototype work is vendor-side.

AI-Assisted Presentation Production.note: The deterministic offline drafting engine extracts claims, headings, and metrics from supplied content. No external model is contacted and generated text is flagged for human fact-check.

Automation, APIs, Macros, and Batch Prod.note: Repeatable local pipeline, regression diff, and approved external conversion. Vendor APIs, VBA, and UNO scripting are not executed.

Presentation Security, Privacy, and Gove.note: Sensitive-content scan, PII and external-link review, metadata guidance, and least-privilege notes; permission changes happen in the hosting platform.

Domain Presentation Solutions.note: Domain frameworks (investor, sales, academic, research, technical, training, status, campaign, event, portfolio) drive the slide plan.

Advanced Agent Orchestration for Present.note: pipeline chains every stage with checkpoints, benchmark compares candidate decks on one brief, capabilities maps each catalog entry to its handler.
